passages.title: A Summer Music Festival
passages.text: Every year, thousands of music fans travel to the countryside for the Sunny Beats Festival. It is one of the most popular events in the region, and tickets often sell out months in advance. The festival (1) ______ place over three days in July, offering a wide variety of musical styles ranging from rock to electronic dance music. Many people choose to camp on-site, which allows them to fully (2) ______ the atmosphere of the event. There are several stages, so festival-goers can easily move between them to see their favourite bands. Food stalls are available everywhere, serving delicious snacks from all over the world. If you are (3) ______ of going this year, make sure to book your accommodation early as nearby hotels fill up very quickly. Organisers have also (4) ______ a new shuttle bus service to help people get to the site more easily. It is a fantastic way to (5) ______ new music and meet people who share your interests. Don't forget to bring comfortable shoes, as you will (6) ______ a lot of time walking between the different stages!

questions.question: Choose the correct option for gap 1.
questions.explanation: The phrase 'takes place' is the correct collocation for an event occurring at a specific time.

questions.question: Choose the correct option for gap 2.
questions.explanation: To 'experience' an atmosphere is the correct verb choice in this context.

questions.question: Choose the correct option for gap 3.
questions.explanation: 'Thinking of' is the correct prepositional phrase to express intention.

questions.question: Choose the correct option for gap 4.
questions.explanation: 'Introduced' is the correct verb to use when something new is started or presented.

questions.question: Choose the correct option for gap 5.
questions.explanation: 'Discover' is the most appropriate verb for finding new music.
